confirmed_repairs.repair: Restored source-visible title/author/editor block: `Zur Theorie der Polynomideale und Resultanten. / Von Kurt Hentzelt dagger. / Bearbeitet von Emmy Noether in Goettingen 1).`
Moved source footnote marker `1)` from the main result display to the editor line.
Converted source notes `2)` through `13)` from ordinary LaTeX footnotes to explicit source-numbered notes.
Corrected formula (15): source has `\sum \alpha_i(u)\Phi_i(y)=\sum \alpha_i(u)F_i(x)` and `F_i(x)\equiv0(\overline{\mathfrak m})`, not the stale lambda version ending in `0(\mathfrak m)`.
Corrected the isomorphism sentence so the source maps from `\Gmod^*_1\mid\Mmod_1` to `\Gmod^*_1\mid\Mmod^*_1`; the stale cumulative omitted the star in the first source.
Converted tail source notes `14)` through `19)` from ordinary LaTeX footnotes to explicit source-numbered notes, with targeted 1000dpi readability crops for pp.70, 73, 75, 77, and 79.
